parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State **three** pieces of evidence provided by the photoelectric effect for a particulate nature of electromagnetic radiation.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the energy, in $\text{eV}$, of a photon of electromagnetic radiation of wavelength $380\,\text{nm}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Determine which metals will give rise to the emission of photoelectrons. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Photons of wavelength $380\,\text{nm}$ are incident normally on a metal surface at a rate of $7.6 \times 10^{14}\,\text{s}^{-1}$. All the photons are absorbed in the surface and no photoelectrons are emitted.

Calculate the force exerted on the metal surface by the incident photons.
